profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Yahoo
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer at Yahoo with a Bachelor of Science in Information Science and Technology from Penn State. Currently contributing to innovative software solutions with a strong focus on algorithm design and AWS Lambda. Previous experience at Amazon Web Services, Listrak, and Deloitte has honed skills in computer science and cloud technologies. Known for collaborative problem-solving and driving impactful projects across diverse teams and organizations.
